show.description: Homeless Husband follows Kunal, a self-made ad agency owner, and Nisha, a runaway bride from the powerful Singhaniya family, who accidentally become flatmates. Their constant fights slowly turn into chemistry as secrets, broken engagements, corporate betrayal, and family pressure test them. Facing office politics, scandals, and heartbreak, they eventually discover that home is each other. Watch now.
